Column 1: Outcome area 1: strengthened capacity for research and development in and the assessment of synthetic biology Objective: actors have improved capacity and infrastructure for undertaking research and development, assessments, monitoring and regulatory oversight of synthetic biology applications that are relevant to the implementation of the three objectives of the Convention on Biological Diversity and the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, while avoiding duplication with the Cartagena Protocol and the Nagoya Protocol.
第 1 欄: 成果領域 1：強化合成生物學研究、開發與評估之能力　目標：行為者在進行與執行《生物多樣性公約》三項目標及《昆明－蒙特婁全球生物多樣性綱要》相關之合成生物學應用的研究、開發、評估、監測與監管監督方面，具備提升之能力與基礎設施，同時避免與卡塔赫納生物安全議定書及名古屋議定書重複。
1.1 需求與優先事項之識別
Column 2: (a) Assess capacities and identify needs related to research and development, access and transfer of technology, regulation, assessment, monitoring and knowledge-sharing in the context of synthetic biology; (b) Prioritize activities for short-, medium- and long-term action on the basis of identified needs and national circumstances; (c) Integrate synthetic biology research and development and assessment needs into various sectoral budget plans, and identify capacity-building and development needs.
第 2 欄: (a) 評估能力，並識別合成生物學背景下與研究、開發、技術取得與轉讓、監管、評估、監測及知識分享相關之需求；(b) 依已識別之需求與國家情況，排定短期、中期與長期行動之優先順序；(c) 將合成生物學研究、開發與評估需求整合至各部門預算計畫中，並識別能力建構與發展需求。

Column 2: (a) Establish, strengthen or provide access to technical laboratory infrastructure, while taking biosafety and biosecurity into account;31 (b) Develop governance mechanisms, technical support and sustainability models to ensure long-term functionality and equitable use of laboratory infrastructure; (c) Develop in silico infrastructure;32 (d) Establish or strengthen laboratories at the national, subregional or regional level; (e) Promote continued and sustainable financing for the maintenance of infrastructure and the procurement of reagents and materials; (f) Integrate physical and digital biosecurity protocols and cyberbiosecurity protocols into the design, operation and maintenance of laboratory and in silico infrastructure.
第 2 欄: (a) 在考量生物安全與生物保安之情況下，建立、強化或提供取得技術實驗室基礎設施之管道；31 (b) 發展治理機制、技術支援與永續模式，以確保實驗室基礎設施之長期功能與公平使用；(c) 發展電腦模擬 (in silico) 基礎設施；32 (d) 在國家、次區域或區域層級建立或強化實驗室；(e) 促進持續且永續之融資，以維護基礎設施並採購試劑與材料；(f) 將實體與數位生物保安規範及網路生物保安 (cyberbiosecurity) 規範，整合至實驗室與電腦模擬基礎設施之設計、運作與維護中。

Column 2: (a) Institutionalize capacity-building and development processes and ensure continued capacity-building through global, regional and national institutions, including for assessment, monitoring and regulation, avoiding duplication with the Cartagena Protocol and the Nagoya Protocol; (b) Provide scholarships, internships and mentorships at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels for areas related to research and development in and the assessment of synthetic biology, in particular for students and women from developing countries and indigenous peoples and local communities; (c) Support the development or use of existing exchange programmes as mechanisms to build capacity, transfer knowledge and promote sustained communication and collaboration across relevant stakeholders;
第 2 欄: (a) 將能力建構與發展程序制度化，並透過全球、區域與國家機構確保持續之能力建構，包括評估、監測與監管方面，同時避免與卡塔赫納生物安全議定書及名古屋議定書重複；(b) 在與合成生物學研究、開發與評估相關之領域，提供大學部與研究所層級之獎學金、實習與導師制度，特別是針對來自開發中國家之學生與女性，以及原住民族與地方社區；(c) 支持發展或運用既有交流計畫，作為建構能力、轉移知識，並促進相關利害關係人之間持續溝通與合作之機制；

Column 2: (d) Develop interdisciplinary training programmes for research and development in and the assessment of synthetic biology, including for assessment and monitoring, in national or regional universities and on e-learning platforms, including specialized courses for regulators and decision makers; (e) Foster the training of members of indigenous peoples and local communities in research and development in and the assessment of synthetic biology in locally relevant languages and in line with their self-determined needs and priorities.
第 2 欄: (d) 在國家或區域大學及線上學習平台上，開發合成生物學研究、開發與評估（包括評估與監測）之跨領域培訓計畫，包括針對監管者與決策者之專門課程；(e) 促進以當地相關語言，並依原住民族與地方社區自行決定之需求與優先事項，培訓其成員從事合成生物學研究、開發與評估。

Column 1: 1.4 Development of capacity for local research and development
第 1 欄: 1.4 在地研究與開發能力之發展
Column 2: (a) Develop national or regional road maps for research and development and responsible innovation in synthetic biology, including through convening national or regional workshops; (b) Support standardization and best practices within the field of synthetic biology, as appropriate and in accordance with national circumstances and priorities; (c) Establish regional and international centres of excellence, networks of laboratories or research consortiums, in particular in developing countries, for activities conducted in the field of synthetic biology; (d) Strengthen research on local genetic resources, including through the provision of grants for local research.
第 2 欄: (a) 制定合成生物學研究、開發與負責任創新之國家或區域路線圖，包括召開國家或區域工作坊；(b) 在適當且符合國家情況與優先事項之情況下，支持合成生物學領域之標準化與最佳實務；(c) 建立區域及國際卓越中心、實驗室網路或研究聯盟，特別是在開發中國家，以進行合成生物學領域之活動；(d) 強化對在地遺傳資源之研究，包括提供在地研究補助金。

Column 2: (a) For Parties to the Cartagena Protocol, use associated actions under Goal A.5 of the capacity-building action plan for the Protocol33 for synthetic biology applications; (b) Strengthen existing national and international procedures, where appropriate, for the environmental impact assessment of synthetic biology applications, in line with Article 14 of the Convention and avoiding the creation of duplicative regulatory processes; (c) Ensure public participation and engagement with a diverse range of experts, including from indigenous peoples and local communities, women, youth, academia and other relevant stakeholders, in the assessment of synthetic biology applications; (d) Fund and strengthen research programmes to improve assessment and monitoring capacity for the potential positive and potential negative impacts of synthetic biology; (e) Strengthen national capacities in anticipatory approaches, assessment and monitoring to identify recent developments in synthetic biology with potential positive and potential negative impacts on the objectives of the Convention; (f) Develop science-based standards to assess and ensure the reliability of biocontainment systems, in accordance with national legislation.
第 2 欄: (a) 對於卡塔赫納生物安全議定書之締約方，將該議定書能力建構行動計畫長期目標 A.5 下之相關行動33 用於合成生物學應用；(b) 在適當情況下，依《公約》第 14 條並避免建立重複之監管程序，強化現有針對合成生物學應用進行環境影響評估之國家與國際程序；(c) 確保公眾參與，並在合成生物學應用之評估中，與多元專家（包括來自原住民族與地方社區、女性、青年、學術界及其他相關利害關係人之專家）互動；(d) 資助並強化研究計畫，以提升對合成生物學潛在正面與潛在負面影響之評估與監測能力；(e) 強化預期性作法、評估與監測方面之國家能力，以識別合成生物學中對《公約》目標具潛在正面與潛在負面影響之最新發展；(f) 依國家立法，制定以科學為基礎之標準，以評估並確保生物圍堵系統之可靠性。

Column 1: Outcome area 2: improved access to and transfer of technology relevant to synthetic biology Objective: access to and the transfer of technology are essential for the attainment of the three objectives of the Convention and the Framework. Thus, the objective of outcome area 2 is to ensure access to synthetic biology technology that is relevant to the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity and does not result in significant damage to the environment, and to create enabling environments that facilitate the transfer of such technology, in line with Articles 16 and 19 of the Convention
第 1 欄: 成果領域 2：改善與合成生物學相關之技術取得與轉移　目標：技術之取得與轉移對達成《公約》與綱要之三項目標至關重要。因此，成果領域 2 之目標，是確保能取得與生物多樣性保育及永續利用相關且不會對環境造成重大損害之合成生物學技術，並營造有利環境以促進此類技術之轉移，符合《公約》第 16 條與第 19 條

Column 1: 2.1. Increased access to and transfer of technology
第 1 欄: 2.1. 增加技術之取得與轉移
Column 2: (a) Establish public-private, public-private-academic and academic-private partnerships on technology relevant to research and development in and the assessment of synthetic biology; (b) Develop and maintain an accessible database of tools and methodologies for detection, identification and assessment; (c) Encourage the development and use of open-source tools, low-cost technology platforms and distributed manufacturing models; (d) Invest in and strengthen supply chains, including through cold-chain facilities, national and regional manufacturing and diversified suppliers; (e) Facilitate the import processes for research supplies; (f) Promote and facilitate the sharing of facilities in line with national needs and priorities; (g) Encourage the use of exchange programmes and organize matchmaking events and technology fairs to support the establishment of links among technology providers, regulators, assessors and potential users, including at the regional level;
第 2 欄: (a) 就與合成生物學研究、開發與評估相關之技術，建立公私、公私學及學私夥伴關係；(b) 開發並維護可取得之偵測、鑑定與評估工具及方法資料庫；(c) 鼓勵開發與使用開源工具、低成本技術平台及分散式製造模式；(d) 投資並強化供應鏈，包括透過冷鏈設施、國家與區域製造及多元化供應商；(e) 簡化研究用品之進口程序；(f) 依國家需求與優先事項，促進並便利設施共享；(g) 鼓勵使用交流計畫，並舉辦媒合活動與技術展覽，以支持技術提供者、監管者、評估者與潛在使用者之間建立連結，包括在區域層級；

Column 2: (h) Develop tools and guidance for access to and the transfer of synthetic biology technologies that are relevant to the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity or make use of genetic resources, do not result in significant damage to the environment and are adapted to local economic, social and cultural contexts; (i) Encourage voluntary licensing arrangements on mutually agreed terms for indigenous peoples and local communities; (j) Encourage voluntary reduced licensing rates and transfer of technical knowledge for use in local innovation and non-commercial research in developing countries.
第 2 欄: (h) 開發與合成生物學技術之取得與轉移相關之工具與指引，該等技術須與生物多樣性之保育及永續利用相關或利用遺傳資源、不會對環境造成重大損害，且適應在地經濟、社會與文化脈絡；(i) 鼓勵針對原住民族與地方社區，依共同商定條件訂定自願性授權安排；(j) 鼓勵自願性降低授權費率及轉移技術知識，以供開發中國家之在地創新與非商業研究使用。

Column 1: 2.2. Establishment and/or strengthening of regulatory alignment with existing regulation
第 1 欄: 2.2. 建立及／或強化與現有法規相一致之監管
Column 2: (a) Establish, strengthen and/or maintain functional biosafety frameworks, which for Parties to the Cartagena Protocol should be in accordance with Goal A.1 of the capacity-building action plan for the Protocol;34 (b) Review regulatory frameworks to identify any potential gaps related to synthetic biology and align biosafety systems to address such gaps, as necessary; (c) Establish and/or strengthen national coordination mechanisms for activities related to synthetic biology; (d) Encourage North-South, South-South and triangular cooperation, including through the exchange of scientific knowledge, technical expertise, regulatory experience and best practices related to synthetic biology, while respecting national legislation, national circumstances and the sovereign right of Parties to establish and implement their own regulatory frameworks.
第 2 欄: (a) 建立、強化及／或維持具功能之生物安全架構，卡塔赫納生物安全議定書之締約方應依該議定書能力建構行動計畫之長期目標 A.1；34 (b) 檢視監管架構，以識別與合成生物學相關之任何潛在缺口，並於必要時調整生物安全系統以因應該等缺口；(c) 建立及／或強化與合成生物學相關活動之國家協調機制；(d) 鼓勵南北、南南及三角合作，包括交流與合成生物學相關之科學知識、技術專長、監管經驗及最佳實務，同時尊重國家立法、國家情況，以及締約方建立並實施自身監管架構之主權權利。

Column 1: 2.3. Strengthened strategies to promote fair and equitable benefit-sharing arising from synthetic biology
第 1 欄: 2.3. 強化促進源自合成生物學之公平公正利益分享之策略
Column 2: (a) For Parties to the Nagoya Protocol, use the capacity-building and development action plan for the Protocol35 to strengthen access and benefit-sharing systems; [(b) Support fair and equitable benefit-sharing, including monetary benefit-sharing, from applications of synthetic biology technology, including to support the participation of developing country Parties in research and development and the assessment of synthetic biology;] (c) Encourage equitable and inclusive non-monetary benefit-sharing, in particular for developing countries and indigenous peoples and local communities; (d) Include reciprocity and co-benefit clauses in public-private, public-academic and other partnership or licensing agreements; (e) Develop appropriate tools and mechanisms to promote the fair and equitable sharing of benefits arising from research and development in and the application of synthetic biology technology; (f) Promote measures to respect, preserve and maintain the traditional knowledge, innovations and practices of indigenous peoples and local communities relevant to synthetic biology to ensure that their access and use are obtained only with the free, prior and informed consent36 of the indigenous peoples and local communities concerned and that benefits arising from their utilization are shared in a fair and equitable manner, in accordance with relevant intellectual property frameworks.
第 2 欄: (a) 對於名古屋議定書之締約方，利用該議定書之能力建構與發展行動計畫35 強化取得與利益分享系統；[(b) 支持源自合成生物學技術應用之公平公正利益分享，包括金錢利益分享，亦包括支持開發中國家締約方參與合成生物學之研究、開發與評估；] (c) 鼓勵公平且具包容性之非金錢利益分享，特別是針對開發中國家以及原住民族與地方社區；(d) 在公私、公學及其他夥伴關係或授權協議中納入互惠與共同利益條款；(e) 發展適當之工具與機制，以促進公平公正分享源自合成生物學技術之研究、開發與應用之利益；(f) 促進尊重、保存與維護與合成生物學相關之原住民族與地方社區之傳統知識、創新與實務之措施，以確保僅在取得相關原住民族與地方社區之自由、事先及知情同意36 之情況下，方可取得與利用其知識，且源自其利用之利益依相關智慧財產權架構，以公平公正之方式分享。

Column 1: Outcome area 3: enhanced knowledge-sharing on synthetic biology, including its development, assessment, governance and regulation Objective: knowledge relevant to synthetic biology research, development, assessment and regulation is shared widely, in line with Article 17 of the Convention, and made available for use by all actors for research and development in and the assessment, governance and regulation of synthetic biology
第 1 欄: 成果領域 3：強化合成生物學之知識分享，包括其發展、評估、治理與監管　目標：與合成生物學研究、開發、評估與監管相關之知識依《公約》第 17 條廣泛分享，並提供所有行為者用於合成生物學之研究、開發、評估、治理與監管

Column 2: (a) Promote the publication of open access scientific articles in the field of synthetic biology, while respecting national legislation on the protection of confidential information and sovereignty over genetic resources; (b) Promote the publication of relevant information in public databases, in line with national legislation and the principles of findability, accessibility, interoperability and reusability (FAIR principles) and of collective benefit, authority to control, responsibility and ethics (CARE principles);
第 2 欄: (a) 促進合成生物學領域開放取用科學論文之發表，同時尊重關於保護機密資訊及遺傳資源主權之國家立法；(b) 依國家立法，並依可尋獲、可取得、可互通及可再利用 (FAIR 原則) 與集體利益、控制權、責任及倫理 (CARE 原則) 之原則，促進相關資訊於公開資料庫中發布；

Column 2: (c) Encourage capacity-building on data stewardship, data curation and long-term data management, including or improving transparency, metadata standards and the handling of confidential information; (d) Promote the sharing of scientific and technical knowledge related to research and development and assessment of synthetic biology, including through the clearing-house mechanisms of the Convention and its Protocols; (e) Support facilitated access to scientific journals and technical databases for researchers and students from developing countries; (f) Establish synthetic biology information hubs to improve access to relevant information.
第 2 欄: (c) 鼓勵關於資料管理、資料策展及長期資料管理之能力建構，包括或改善透明度、詮釋資料標準及機密資訊之處理；(d) 促進分享與合成生物學研究、開發及評估相關之科學與技術知識，包括透過《公約》及其議定書之資訊交換機制；(e) 支持為來自開發中國家之研究人員與學生提供取得科學期刊與技術資料庫之便利；(f) 建立合成生物學資訊樞紐，以改善相關資訊之取得。

Column 1: 3.2. Establishment of knowledge-sharing initiatives and mechanisms
第 1 欄: 3.2. 建立知識分享倡議與機制
Column 2: (a) Convene national, regional and international knowledge-sharing events on synthetic biology and related areas, including, as appropriate, regulatory aspects, assessment and oversight, and promote participation in relevant regional and international gatherings, in particular for developing countries; (b) Support the participation of researchers and students in dedicated competitions; (c) Establish knowledge-sharing and cooperation agreements among institutions and promote participation in international or regional research networks; (d) Provide international scholarships and internships for knowledge-sharing initiatives on synthetic biology, in particular for developing countries, women and youth; (e) Facilitate the participation of researchers from developing countries and representatives of indigenous peoples and local communities in international two-way knowledge-sharing events; (f) Encourage, as appropriate, regulatory learning exchanges among countries; (g) Promote knowledge-sharing activities that are inclusive of all relevant rights holders and stakeholders; (h) Promote regional, international, North-South, South-South and triangular cooperation on synthetic biology and ecological research.
第 2 欄: (a) 召開關於合成生物學及相關領域之國家、區域與國際知識分享活動，包括（視情況）監管面向、評估與監督，並促進參與相關區域與國際集會，特別是針對開發中國家；(b) 支持研究人員與學生參與專門競賽；(c) 建立機構間之知識分享與合作協議，並促進參與國際或區域研究網路；(d) 為合成生物學知識分享倡議提供國際獎學金與實習機會，特別是針對開發中國家、女性與青年；(e) 促進來自開發中國家之研究人員及原住民族與地方社區代表參與國際雙向知識分享活動；(f) 視情況鼓勵國家間之監管學習交流；(g) 促進涵蓋所有相關權利持有者與利害關係人之知識分享活動；(h) 促進關於合成生物學與生態研究之區域、國際、南北、南南及三角合作。

Column 2: (a) Encourage the publication of technical materials and scientific publications in local languages; (b) Support the development of scientific and operational modules in local languages, co-developed with stakeholders; (c) Facilitate public awareness through the use of a variety of media and of local languages; (d) Conduct dialogues and awareness campaigns that are accessible, multilingual and adapted to diverse audiences, including the general public, indigenous peoples and local communities, women and youth; (e) Hold dedicated forums and public consultations with the participation of indigenous peoples and local communities, civil society organizations, women, youth, regulators and the scientific community; (f) Promote the organization of public research discovery days in universities to facilitate the dissemination of knowledge related to synthetic biology and its potential impacts.
第 2 欄: (a) 鼓勵以在地語言發表技術資料與科學出版物；(b) 支持與利害關係人共同開發以在地語言編製之科學與操作模組；(c) 透過使用多種媒體與在地語言，促進公眾認知；(d) 辦理可近用、多語言並適應多元受眾（包括一般大眾、原住民族與地方社區、女性與青年）之對話與認知提升活動；(e) 舉辦專門論壇與公眾諮詢，並由原住民族與地方社區、公民社會組織、女性、青年、監管者及科學界參與；(f) 促進在大學舉辦公眾研究發現日，以利傳播與合成生物學及其潛在影響相關之知識。

Column 2: (a) Prioritize intercultural dialogues in knowledge construction through mechanisms that respect and integrate diverse knowledge systems, languages and transmission modes, while ensuring effective participation based on free, prior and informed consent, culturally appropriate engagement and respect for traditional knowledge and gender perspectives; (b) Foster two-way learning between scientific institutions and indigenous peoples and local communities.
第 2 欄: (a) 優先透過尊重並整合多元知識系統、語言與傳遞方式之機制，於知識建構中進行跨文化對話，同時確保基於自由、事先及知情同意之有效參與、符合文化適切性之參與，並尊重傳統知識與性別觀點；(b) 促進科學機構與原住民族與地方社區之間的雙向學習。
